address: Bachleda Kasprowy Hotel, ul. Szymaszkowa 20, Zakopane, 34-500, Poland

tags.name: Pets allowed only in outdoor dining areas (patio/terrace)

bio: Nestled within the Bachleda hotel, this well-run restaurant provides the perfect restoration after a tiring day skiing on the nearby slopes. Go for a table by the window if you can, so you can make the most of the views of the Tatra Mountains, then order from the comfortingly classic menu that specialises in prime cuts cooked over charcoal. From a range of steaks to local lamb, it’s hearty, satisfying fare. Don’t miss the apple pie with cinnamon ice cream to finish.
